model_provenance_limit: The requested configuration is preserved. Model identity is not inferred from artifact files.
independence: The reviewer did not produce or modify source, requirement, network, or role artifacts or producer scripts. The reviewer wrote only independent findings, review reports, and review binding evidence.
remaining_defect_claim_boundary: All nine identified plan findings are resolved in the bound revision. No additional extraction defect was identified within the stated review scope. The review is not a proof that every possible semantic defect is absent.

scope.requirement_review_detail: Read all 76 theorem statements, applicability and qualification fields, requirement-strength summaries, all active numbered requirement text, source prose, and all retained issue/scope classifications. Exact requirement/context quotations and source assignments were checked independently.
scope.background_review_detail: Inspected all background prose and trailing-text records and modal/table candidates. Verified all numbered background requirements are relocated or withdrawn. The orphan reference year was corrected.
scope.network_review_detail: Reviewed all example topology/role/link summaries and every mapping rationale, selected clause, condition, evidence basis, and qualification. Compared visual claims against every figure crop. Schematics and textual configurations are not deployed instances.
scope.pipeline_review_detail: Inspected retained-source selection, source partition/table reconstruction, requirement/background status and rendering, network-role corrections, reconciler and scope rendering, validators, summary generation, and regression tests. Script hashes identify reproduction dependencies; the review does not claim a formal proof of every producer implementation path.

independent_mechanical_checks.scope: Independent direct comparisons of current structured artifacts. Source-span and PDF-character coverage are separate producer-validator checks, not independently reimplemented here.
checks: one unique theorem target per group and none for background
current mapping qualifications and issue references
exact role evidence and mention spans

focused_tests.result: 17 tests passed in independent auditor invocation

source_mechanical_validation.boundary: The source validator checks every searchable non-whitespace character, exact baseline spans, and an external Perl count. Independent review checked direct delivered-record equality and the listed source pixels. Full glyph-by-glyph visual inspection of all 66 pages was not performed.

semantic_assessment.source_representation: The repaired RFC 4303 row preserves its full publication date. Contextualized rows retain headers, merged-cell relations, applicable notes, and original fragments.
semantic_assessment.requirement_grouping: One candidate top-level theorem per group remains explicit. Ten source interpretation questions and one external-scope limitation remain open. No additional missing active numbered obligation was identified.
semantic_assessment.background: The 647 remaining units preserve reasons and source IDs. Fifteen relocated and five withdrawn numbered rows remain background. No additional active obligation was identified as misplaced during the stated background review.
semantic_assessment.networks: Clause-scoped source presentation replaces blanket compliance treatment. Forty satisfying judgments concern selected source designs or alternatives; whole-solution implementation compliance remains unassessed. Missing details do not establish violations.
semantic_assessment.roles: The final inventory adds IKE initiator/responder roles with exact mentions and no invented Bob/Alice assignment. Inferred device placeholders in NET-021 and NET-022 were removed.
semantic_assessment.scope_classification: AW-host/VM and data/management separation conditions apply cumulatively. Legal-domain review is confined to RG-076. Ordinary illustration/proof limits are acknowledged and nonblocking.

open_source_issues.title: Standalone encapsulator boundary and requirement strength conflict
open_source_issues.detail: §4.2.3 and §5.5 require all Solution Component obligations; below Figure 8 the encapsulation step is outside the solution with DM/PF highly recommended; MD-13 mandates §11.1 treatment. Resolve applicability without silently deleting any passage.

open_source_issues.title: Same-level filtering sentence conflicts with the permitted peers
open_source_issues.detail: §5.2 says to prevent same-security-level communication. Other provisions allow same-level tunnels and prohibit different-level communication. The original words remain uncorrected.

open_source_issues.title: Management encryption and local exceptions
open_source_issues.detail: Broad two-layer Gray-management wording coexists with direct physical-management exceptions, LAN/VLAN qualification, and a same-site CNSA exemption. The scope of each exception needs a formal applicability decision.

open_source_issues.title: TRANSEC requirement strength and applicability differ
open_source_issues.detail: Public-Internet prose says must, while OR-9 is Objective for MACsec connected to an Outer Firewall and has a blank Alternatives cell.

open_source_issues.title: New-version compliance deadline conflict
open_source_issues.detail: §13.3 specifies six months from notification; GD-11 specifies the next registration renewal. No precedence is supplied.

open_source_issues.title: AS connection scope wording
open_source_issues.detail: The prose says AS must not connect to both Gray and/or Red Networks; AA-2 says only one site’s network. Network/layer/site cardinality needs a source-faithful formal definition.

open_source_issues.title: Gray address-only restrictions and explicit non-tunnel exceptions
open_source_issues.detail: Only-peer-address rules must be interpreted with the separately enumerated management/control/revocation allowances; blindly conjoining unqualified allowlists would lose allowed traffic.

open_source_issues.title: Objective table row has no Alternative marker
open_source_issues.detail: PF-10 is Objective with a blank Alternatives cell despite §8.1 describing optional objectives as marked Optional. Preserve the blank and seek review.

open_source_issues.title: MACsec provisioning paragraph uses VPN terminology
open_source_issues.detail: The certificate-based MACsec paragraph names the Inner VPN Gateway CSR. Do not silently correct the quotation; identify the intended device in later formalization.

open_source_issues.title: External annex dependencies are not supplied
open_source_issues.detail: Key management, symmetric key management, continuous monitoring, enterprise Gray implementation, and testing annex contents are outside the supplied PDF. Relocation markers are preserved in background, with referents; their substantive obligations cannot be recovered here.

open_source_issues.title: EAP-TLS CAK derivation and blanket KGS generation wording
open_source_issues.detail: The authentication prose derives a CAK from the EAP-TLS MSK, then says all CAKs and CKNs must be generated by an NSA-approved KGS. The applicability of the KGS requirement to the certificate-derived branch must be resolved without changing either quotation.

domain_review_scope.title: Legal-domain interpretation remains unreviewed
domain_review_scope.detail: The legal undertaking is retained as a non-network obligation. Its formal applicability and any legal meaning need dedicated review; the extraction makes no enforceability claim.

evidence_scope_notes.title: Figures and protocol examples do not prove compliance
evidence_scope_notes.detail: Figures and protocol examples support source-grounded, clause-specific requirement assessments. Implementation tests and theorem proofs require later evidence and models. That ordinary evidence boundary does not prevent extracting the requirements illustrated by an example.

resolved_interpretations.title: AW host and VM restrictions apply together
resolved_interpretations.detail: §6.2 prohibits the AW host from hosting enrollment/provisioning/registration/SIEM VMs. DM-24 refers to separate workstations or VMs. The host-level scope must remain visible.
resolved_interpretations.resolution: Separate service VMs must also respect the AW host restriction. Distinct VMs do not authorize provisioning, enrollment, registration, or SIEM VMs on an AW-dedicated host.

resolved_interpretations.title: Physical, cryptographic, and ACL separation apply together
resolved_interpretations.detail: §4.1.4 requires physical and cryptographic data/management separation and says VLAN alone is insufficient; DM-25 states at least logical separation by Gray Firewall ACL. Retain both requirements.
resolved_interpretations.resolution: The minimum logical separation required by DM-25 does not waive the physical and cryptographic separation in §4.1.4. The conditions can be imposed together.

limits: No theorem statement was proved or model consistency established.
No live network or configured deployment was tested.
External annex contents and legal enforceability were not reviewed.
The scoped mapping set covers illustrated and feature-triggered clauses. Unmapped groups are unassessed rather than exempted.
Whole-document text review and targeted pixel checks do not equal exhaustive visual inspection of all PDF glyphs.
Historical no-defect claims were not accepted as current proof. The historical review remains unchanged.

historical_review.disposition: Preserved as historical evidence. The old zero-defect conclusion missed the per-clause mapping defect, a broken reference row, and omitted protocol roles.

memory_use: Prior TDN memory notes guided source-fidelity and historical-review cautions. Current findings and corrections were checked against the present PDF and artifacts.
